subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should `MemoryCorpusSupplement.search` officially accept `AbortSignal` and allow memory-wiki supplements to return digest-only partial results when the digest underfills within the shared tool deadline?
rationale: This changes an exported plugin API and existing recall-completeness behavior, so implementation plausibility cannot substitute for owner intent.

options.title: Approve bounded supplement contract
options.body: Document optional cancellation and digest-only underfill behavior, add focused contract coverage, and require live large-vault proof.

options.title: Narrow to memory-wiki
options.body: Remove the shared signal API addition and retain only the memory-wiki fallback change after owner approval.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive recall
options.body: Reject digest-only supplement behavior and pursue a fully abortable or indexed fallback design.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded supplement contract
recommendation.body: Document optional cancellation and digest-only underfill behavior, add focused contract coverage, and require live large-vault proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the exported supplement contract and the memory-wiki fallback behavior being changed.
